How these guides are made

We use manufacturer specifications and official shop or event guidance, linked beside the relevant information. Product examples illustrate how to read a listing; they are not hands-on reviews or stock recommendations. Our diagrams and calculations explain their assumptions.

Each guide includes a source-check date. Check the current seller or organiser page before ordering: specifications, availability and event conditions can change.
